༄༅// gtsug lag khang chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// mnyam pa'i bṛtta rnam byed ldan la prāstā ra sa ya brgyad rjes 'brangs bcas/ yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba nyer gsum rjes 'brangs bcas/ yi ge dung phyur rjes 'brangs bcas/ lci yang bye ba dgu rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo dung phyur rjes 'brangs bcas/ a dhwa 'phred zhe lnga/ steng 'og bye ba gcig rjes 'brangs bcas naṣṭa gzhung gis dngos su ma zin pa uddhiṣṭa sa ya gnyis rjes 'brangs bcas pas mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// sarb+bābhawādzñeyo3sheṣaparisphuṭodzñānākāshatanwadasīmukhodaro3meyaṃmahākāruṇyo3mpudharoghanatwabyūhaṃmanodzñābyūnnatātkutsaḥ ༄༅// shes shis par brjod pa'i sgo gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ bya'i dngos kun ma lus yongs khyab ye shes kun gsal lus phra'i bzhin ras mtha' gru yangs// dpag yas thugs rje chen po'i chu 'dzin stug po nyid bkod nu 'bur yid 'ong mngon mtho las// ༄༅// karmānirābhogasyāmṛtawarṣadhārāngshurmuktikaudzaṃkāmadohanambodhitrayāṇāṃkaulyāgradzanīkwatsadrakṣant+waṅkuraṃbuddhoghanāmbayā// ༄༅// phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i char rgyun zil dngar mu tig mdangs su 'tsher ba 'dod pa 'jo// byang chub gsum gyi rigs mchog myu gu ci yang bskyed bsring sangs rgyas sprin gyi ma mas skyongs// gang gi bzhi ga'i thog mar yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan gyi phyag bya ba/ rang bzhin 'khrugs pa med par bdag tu lta ba'i thibs po mtha' dag bcad cing gtubs// gang de rjes su chags las grol yang tshul bzhin sgrub la legs pa'i yon tan ci yang ster// gang zhig 'khor ba'i nyes pas 'tsho min yang ni khams gsum pa yi nyon mongs zad par za// gang las thog mtha' bar du legs pa'i dpal kun 'byung ba dam pa'i chos la spyi bos mchod// lus med

mtha' dag gzugs can/ thul gyis legs par gdams pa'i nyi zer gyis phye blo gros 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor yangs// bgrang ba las 'das yon tan ge sar khong nas 'dzum dbus legs bshad rkang drug dbyangs su 'jo// gcig tu gzhan don spyod pa'i rgya mtshor dgyes dgur spyod kyang khams gsum nyes pas ring du dben// dus gsum sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rnams dang rkyen rtogs dgra bcom tshogs mchog padma'i phreng bar dad// srid pa'i rmad byung gi dpe/ snang byed 'od rtse dang 'grogs thun mtshams chu 'dzin mtshar sdug de// dran pas mi shes mun pa legs sbyangs snang ba mchog gi rtse dga' la// yang dag sbyor ba'i mthu chen thob na khyod sku bcu drug lang tsho yi// rjes su rkang pa nye bar 'jog go /zur phud lnga ldan lhag pa'i lha// sna tshogs rab spel/ nor bu bstar ba'i 'og pag drwa ba drwa phyed dpyangs ba'i dkur// brten pa shel gyi rgyud mangs ngos su phyag gi lcug phran gzhon nu dag /bsnun pa las byung sgra dbyangs dang 'grogs gtsug lag rab 'byams snyan dngags glur// rtag tu 'jo ma dbyangs kyi rgyal mo mgrin pa padma'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs// thugs bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ bskyed thog ma'i bskal pa nyid nas gdul dka'i skye bo srid pa las// yang dag thabs kyi gdon pa'i g.yar dam yi ge dam pa snying gar bkod// dus 'dir ngag gi rgyal pos byin brlabs rgyal ba nyid dang dgongs gcig tshul// 'doms pa'i dbang phyug sa skya par grags rje btsun rnam lnga'i bka' drin bsams// 'jig yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ rten mes po'i gdangs kyi 'gyur khugs phra mor byed pa tshad ma'i lung*// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su 'phos pas gang zhig chos la mkhas pa'i las// dpag yas bgyis mthar gya nom bde bas 'byor pa'i zhing du de 'gro zhes// thabs shes yi ge zung 'jug rol mo phyogs bral snyan pa kun dga' bzang*// dpal

rab rtog dpe/ mchog thub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin gang gi /yon tan pha rol nga dang mnyam nyid du// yangs par song snyam ma rgyags sprin gos can// kun mchog chos kyi skus kyang co 'drir dogs// tshogs zung bsdus gzugs/ rin chen mang 'byung gnas las byung*// bkra shis mtshan bzang g.yas su 'khyil ba las// legs par gsungs pa lhun grub sgra dbyangs kyis// mi mthun rims nad bcil ba chos dung che// dpal bsam pa rgya che ba/ ldan rdo rje 'chang gi gnas de yang*// gang 'dis skad cig gcig bgrod ngal ba ci// 'on te snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal kun gyi// phrin las bar med chos kyis skyong la zhugs// rab tu spel ba/ ched du byas min lhun grub dge mtshan stong*// sa stengs 'di na 'phos snyam chos kyi grwar// mdo sngags chos kyi tshul chen mi zad gter// smra ba mkhas pa'i nyin byed gang byon dang*// ཾsde cha shas gcig pa'i gzugs can/ bzhi phun sum tshogs ldan rgyal thabs khrir// bgrod byed rnam bkod khrims gnyis 'khor lo yis// nor ldan brtan ma dbang sgyur mi yi rje// snying stobs daṃge ba kun la gus btud nas// kha yan lag gcig gzugs can/ ba ri ba'i brdas drangs bka' lung gi /rnam 'grel 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi gandho la// chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs bskrun pa las// nyer brtsams mchid kyi sgra brnyan cung zad brdung*// mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ mong rtul rna ba gtod par mi byed mod// blo gsal rmongs pa'i spyod tshul ci ste 'dzin// dmus long btang snyoms byas pa'i ltad mo la// lta byed ldan pas kyang ni de 'os sam// khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos mtshungs shing mi mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod/ yid 'ong bsil ba'i go 'phang kun la 'bebs// mngon 'dod 'bras bu bsgugs la nye bar ster// rtsa brtan lo 'dab kun nas rgyas gyur pa'i// ljon pa'i mchog 'di rnyed pa skal ba bzang*// srid gsum mchod 'os bla med dkon mchog gsum// rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor shar ba yi// ngo mtshar gtam du gleng 'di skal ba yi// bskos pa'i min nam bdag ni spro ba skyes// zhes mchod par brjod cing dngos po nges par bstan pa nyung zad kyis sngun bsus te/

skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ rang re rnams ston pa bla na med pa rgyal po bu ram shing skyes kyi rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i gnyen gyis legs par gsungs pa'i lugs bzang bdud rtsi mchog gi ro la longs spyod pa'i skal ba mi dman par gyur nas/ gsang gsum yon tan 'dzad pa med pa'i go sar mngon du bgyis pa min pa de srid kyi skye ba lu gu rgyud du dkon mchog gsum las phul du dbyung bar 'os pa'i skyabs gzhan zhig ni gzhar yang rnyed par mi 'gyur ba ni/ rgyud bla mar/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces 'byung ba ltar nges par byas nas/ de dag skyabs su bzung ba'i snying po ni/ ji ltar bslab par bgyi ba'i gnas rnams la rjes su slob cing rjes su sgrub pa dang*/ de dag gi rten gsum gyi gzugs brnyan mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bskrun pa dang*/ de dag bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa dang*/ dgyes pa skyed pa'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pas mdun 'dar nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug dag gi legs nyes kyi blo gtod par som nyi'i drwa ba ma lus pa bcad pa las lhag pa'i bgyi ba ni ci yang bsgrub tu med pa'i phyir ro// de bas na de dag gi don la rjes su dpyod cing 'jug pa la rtse gcig tu 'dun pa'i dpal mi'i dbang phyug dam pa sdom brtson bla ma bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes grags pa'i zla ris dkar pos phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes pa de gang gi thugs bskyed rgya mtsho chen po'i mjing las mngon par 'phags pa'i legs byas rin chen sa 'dzin gyi dbang po'i spun zlar bskrun pa ni/ ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams su yun ring gnas par gyur// zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'i dgongs 'grel gangs can pa'i brdar 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin chen po rtag par 'byung ba'i phyi mo ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul ni ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar par bkod pa ltar dang*/

'dir phyi mo de dag bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtsug lag khang dam pa chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs zhes bya ba rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskrun pa/ brten pa rten gsum ji ltar bskrun pa/ bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs byang*/ brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskrun pa la/ gang du bskrun pa'i gnas dang*/ der ji ltar bskrun pa'o// dang po ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yal ga dang lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu bzang po'i khur gyis kun nas dud pa'i dzambū rkang 'thung gi rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar mtshon pa'i gling dam pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mi shigs rdo rje'i gdan chen por byang chub ljon pa'i dbang po'i drung ga la bar/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas te/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can sde dang bcas pa rmeg med du bcom ste/ bla na ma mchis pa'i byang chub kyi snying po mngon du gyur pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa'i gdong lnga'i rgyud kyi nga ros 'jig rten gyi khams khengs par bsgrags pa la su yang rgol ba med pa'i go 'phang la bzhugs nas/ 'jig rten khams su snga na med pa'i chos kyi snang ba chen po bkye ba'i gnas ni 'phags pa'i yul gyi dbus gyur 'chang ste/ de nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya phrag bgrod par/ bod yul gyi rdo rje'i gdan chen po dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po zhes pa skye dgu yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag bla na med pa nyid du bzhugs pa/ de nyid las kyang shar phyogs kyi 'dzin mar zhag gi phung po gsum tsam brgal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i snying pos yongs su lci ba'i yul gru rnams kyi nang gses/ ma hā bho ṭa ste bod chen por grags pa'i sa'i thig le gang sngon dus gling zhes grags pa la rim gyis rten la brten pa'i ming gis btags pas sde dge zhes grags la/

der mtshungs zlas dben pa'i phun tshogs stobs kyi dpung pas dbang sgyur ba'i sde dge sa skyong kun gyi thog ma'i mes po rngu rje sgu ru zhes grags pa/ rang bzhin bzang po'i yon tan gyis kun nas 'byor bas/ khams gsum chos gyi rgyal po chen po dpal sa skya pa dang*/ gnam bskos se chen gan mchod yon du 'brel ba'i dus su/ las tshan bcu gsum gyi rnam gzhag dar ba'i thog ma gsol dpon gyi las ka zin/ mchod yon zung gi thugs brtses rjes su bskyangs te slar yang mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni// khyim pa 'khor los sgyur rnams su// gyur nas sems can don byed do// zhes 'byung ba ltar mchod yon gyis las rtags dang bka' lung btsan pos stong dbon gyi ge sar dbang bskur/ de nas brtsams te deng gi bar du skyes bu dam pa gang dag byon pa rnams/ las dbang gi shugs gong nas gong du bdo bar gyur cing*/ mdo smad ljongs kyi nor 'dzin brtan ma'i bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor yangs par chos bzhin du bskyang ba la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba/ sdeṃ bzhi'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas mngon par brjid cing*/ gcig tu rnam dkar dgeṃ ba'i spyod pa rgya chen po dag la spro ba mchog tu brtas pas/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po/ bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor brtan par byed pa'i lhag bsam shel gyi ka ba rab tu brling ba/ sngon dus sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po rnams kyi rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho'i rjes su snyegs pa sha stag byung ba rnams kyis legs par bsrungs pa/ mkhas pa dang grub pa mchog gi sa la rdzu 'phrul gyi bgrod byed rnam par bkod pa'i grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ shar chen chos kyi rgyal po byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu sangs rgyas phun tshogs/

mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ thams cad gzigs pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ gnas gsar mkhan chen ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa/ bstan pa'i nyin byed si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas la sogs pa yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal thabs skyong ba mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyi snang bas mu med phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs par mdzad pa'i gdan sa chen po/ dpal sde dge lhun grub steng zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos grwa chen po ste/ de'i nang gses sa skyong rgyal ba'i sras po bstan pa tshe ring gi byang chub spyod pa'i rgya mtsho 'gengs phyir bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi par khang rten dang brten par bcas pa byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bum phrag 'bar bzhin du bzhugs pa/ gang la nye bar brten pa'i sa phyogs ga la ba de nyid du'o// gnyis pa ni/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba dang*/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa bskrun pa ni spros pa dang bcas pa'o// 'jig pa dang bcas pa'o// sdig pa dang bcas pa'o zhes 'gog pa dag ni mu stegs gcer bu pa rnams kyi lugs te/ ji skad du/ kun dga' rwa ba gnas byed dang*// srog gcod pa las bzlog par bya// gal te der ni srog chags 'chi// sdig pa byed de byed la 'go /sems dang ldan pa de 'chi bas// sdig pa chen po nyid du 'gyur// de bas bsod nams rtsom pa dag /de yis de ltar mi bya'o// zhes zer ro// bdag cag gi ston pas ni/ de nyid bsod nams kyi phung po nye bar bsags pa'i rgyur gsungs te/ 'dul ba lung las/ kun dga' rwa ba gtsug lag khang*// mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*// glo bur nad pa'i nad g.yog dang*// yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ni// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun// zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nas/

khyad par 'phags pa'i bstod par/ gcer bu kun dga' rwa ba sogs// brtsigs pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// zhes pa'i rjes su 'jug pa la spro ba dag gis gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzhengs par 'dod pas/ thog mar sa gzhi rang dbang du 'gyur ba dang bkra shis pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag dang gsang chen rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa'i sa'i cho ga ni/ gong du smos pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gis sa brtag pa dang*/ bsrung ba sbyang ba dang gzung ba dang srung ba ci rigs pas lan gcig min par byin gyis brlabs pas sa phyogs thams cad mchod rten lta bur gyur pa'i phyir ma dgos la/ lhag par sa gzhi brtag pa dang*/ mngon pa las bslang ba dang*/ las dang bya bas skyon sbyang ba rnams ni nges par ma dgos shing*/ de las gzhan pa'i cho ga rnams ni slar grub na'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la mnga' sgyur ba'i mkhan po chen po thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/ mkhas btsun grub pa rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang pas mtshon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rab 'byams la 'os pa'i sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum gyis kye rdo rje la brten pa'i sa'i cho ga dang gter gzhug pa dang*/ gzhan yang skar nag rtsis kyi gtsug lag nas bshad pa'i bcos sgrib dgos pa rnams rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang po bla mkhyen bsod nams rgyal dpon g.yog rnams kyis nye bar bsgrubs te/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang gsel legs par sbyar ba'i skad du raktā kṣi zhes pa bod skad du mig dmar te/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming la shing pho byi bar bod pa'i gnam lor/ hor lugs kyi zla ba gnyis pa'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la 'go brtsam/

de'ang las byed kyi bkod par phebs par/ sdom brtson mi bdag chen po'i lung bzang gser gyi cod paṇa spyi bor bcings nas/ kun la blang dor gyi gnas rnams tshul bzhin du 'doms pa la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i blo gros can mdun na 'don chen po gnyer pa lha bu tshe ring dang*/ gtsug lag zung gi shes byar 'jug pa'i rnam dpyod gsal ldan sku srung ba bla ma dge 'dun bcas gung na bzhugs nas/ las kun la blang dor gyi bslab bya ston cing dngos rdzas kyi gtong gzung gi sgo 'phar 'byed bsdams kyi do dam par mkhyen dpyod kyi srang mda' shin tu drang zhing bsod nams kyi mthu che ba par dpon dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan dang*/ de'i grogs ldan du dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin du bgyid pa'i par dpon dge slong rin chen bkra shis dang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gnyis bskos/ thog mar ming don gnyis kar dge zhing bkra shis pa gsum gyis thig btab/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mtha' can gsum gyis rmang bting ba nas brtsams te/ shing gzhog pa dang*/ shing brkos pa dang*/ gyang bzo ba dang*/ zho shas 'tsho ba rnams bcas mi grangs lnga brgya tsam bsags par bza' yon tshul bzhin du sbyar nas lo ngo gnyis su grub par bslangs so// de'i phyi lo zhig tu lha ris pa mang tsam gyis shing rtsi rnams btang ba tshun legs par grub par byas so// smras pa/

phyi rol gyi rgyu cung zad dang bcas te 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can/ ma brtsigs gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i nang*// ma brdal yangs pa bod yul sman gyi ljongs// g.yab mos ma bos yid 'phrog rlung 'jam ldang*// ma bteg chos kyi snying pos mtho ba can// ting 'dzin gyi yon tan/ nang gses chen po bod kyi sa'i thig le// khor yug dbyibs legs ri bo'i mdun gros shom// tshang tshing dga' tshal ljon pa'i grib bsil 'jo// nyal 'gro ma rnams chal chil sgra brnyan brdung*// smad pa'i dpe/ legs bris longs spyod ngoms med thar pa'i dgra// dpag bsam gtong ba chos kyi sbyin pas dbul// de dag mtshungs las sdeṃ bzhi'i dpal kun gyis// 'byor pa'i daṃge mtshan rdzogs 'di khyad par 'phags// de dngos po'i dpe/ na rgyu 'bras theg pa'i bshad sgrub dbyangs// lhunaṃ gyis grubaṃ par 'jo byed ngur smrig 'chang*// bgrang yas bsti ba'i khang chen khang phran ni// rgyu skar phreng ba sa stengaṃs bkram pa bzhin// de 'byor ba rgya che ba/ dbus dbang sngon zhun ma'i khyams sngon mo// gzugs brnyan brgya phrag snang ba'i ltad mo can// nor bu'i ka bas rab bteg gdung cam la// yid 'phrog gzugs kyi ri mo ci yang bkra// 'gram sems med rab rtog logs rtsig pa pha gu lan kan sogs// bkod legs brgya byin khang pa'i ya mtshan gyi// dum bu sa stengs 'di na lhung ngo zhes// drwa ba dril chung ga zha 'byin snyam byed// e waṃ yi ges mtshan pa'i me long dang*// gser 'od phyogs su 'phro ba'i 'gan 'ji ras// gnas 'dir 'jug la sgrib pa dang po nas// sbyong la chos kyi pho nya bzhin du yod// gtsug lag khang chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng las rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskrun pa'i skabs te dang po'o//

//gnyis pa brten pa rten gsum ji ltar bskrun pa la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa/ dngos po bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la'ang dgos pa dang*/ snga phyir gang byung dpyad pa/ de dag gi tshad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten du mi snang bar mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan na'ang*/ de'i rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi khams su thugs rje'i 'jug pa ni nam yang mi yol bar don byed de/ 'dul ba lung las/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas// dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur srid kyi// de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje ni// nam yang dus las yol ba med// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems can kun gyi bya ba la// khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas// mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba// mi mnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ lha dbang dang*/ lha'i rnga dang*/ sprin dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ nor bu la sogs pa'i dpe'i sgo nas bstan pa rgya cher 'byung ba ltar/ gzhan don 'byung ba nam yang yol ba med cing*/ khyad par sems can khams kyi bde legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa las 'byung dgos shing*/ de nyid yun du gnas pa dang*/ gang de 'dzin skyong spel gsum mam bshad sgrub zung gis 'phel bar byed pa la'ang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum byin rlabs can bzhugs pa la rag las pa'i phyir ro// 'dir skabs su babs pa sku'i rten gyi dgos pa ni/ sman bla don grub pas/ 'gro 'di'i phun tshogs gang la rag las pa// bstan pa gnas dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba yi// sku gzugs sgrub tshul yid bzhin nor bu 'di// mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs 'dir bshad bya// zhes so// des na bdag bde legs su 'dod pa rnams ni sku gzugs bzheng ba la shin tu rtun pa bskyed par byar rigs te/

dam pa'i chos padma dkar po las/ la las de bzhin rin chen gzugs byas pa// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan pa'i gzugs// gang gis de phyir byas pa de dag kyang*// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// la las der ni rin chen sna bdun dang*// la las de bzhin zangs dang 'khar ba las// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas te// lta na sdug pa 'jim pa'i las byed bcug /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsod nams brgya mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// bdag gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung*// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bslab btus las/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad la 'dod yon lnga'i sbyin pa byin pa las/ dge bsnyen rnam dag gcig la bsnyen bkur ba bsod nams ches khyad par 'phags so// de thams cad las ni dge tshul gcig la'o// de thams cad las ni dge slong gcig la'o// de thams cad las ni rdo rje 'dzin pa gcig la'o// de thams cad la bsnyen bkur ba las ni sku gzugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mtshon gang ba cig bzhengs pa bsod nams ches khyad par 'phags so zhes dang*/ gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsod nams brgya mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// bdag gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung*// de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phan yon de dag 'thob pa'i dgos pa dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ sngags pa las ni dang po pas// gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste// bris sku bsgrubs na myung bar ni// dngos grub rgya chen 'thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyud 'grel las kyang ji ltar gsungs pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i nus pa med pas/

bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pas lha'i rnam pa bsgom par bya'o// de'ang gzugs brnyan ma mthong ba las mi nus so zhes pa'i don gyis 'phangs pa'i thang sku dang sku gzugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kho na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rgyu yin la zhes/ las dang po pas bskyed rim gsal ba'i thabs kyang byed cing*/ goms pas dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten yang byed la/ mthar thug sku gnyis 'grub par byed pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu yang byed do// gnyis pa ni/ sku'i rten la bris 'bur gnyis las/ dang po ri mor bris pa snga ba'i tshul ni/ sngon dus mi rnams tshe lo 'bum las mar 'bri ba'i tshe mi'i rgyal po 'jigs thul zhes bya ba byung ste/ des rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs pas mi rnams kyi tshe lo dpag tu med par 'phel bar gyur nas bde skyid dang ldan par gyur to// rgyal pos kyang dka' thub chen po spyad pas dbang phyug gi yon tan thob cing*/ bstan bcos thams cad shes pa dang mi'i yul du lha'i mtshon dang dmag gis mi phebs pa'i mchog byin no// rgyal po de'i 'bangs bram ze zhig la bu gces pa cig yod pa dus byas nas/ bram zes rgyal po'i rtsar phyin te lhas chos bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs pa min pa 'dra ste/ 'bangs la dus min gyi 'chi ba byung ste bdag gi bu phrogs so// kho bor bu mi stsol na lceb bo// rgyal pos bram ze de gshin rje'i rgyal po'i drung na khrid de/ de la phyag byas nas bram ze'i bu stsal du gsol smras pas/ des bdag gis ma nongs te rang gi las su zad do// slar rgyal pos byin cig dang des mi rung ngo zhes yang yang smras mthar g.yul gshom ste 'thab pa na/ rgyal pos lha'i mtshon chas gshin rje'i 'khor pham par byas/ gshin rjes dbyug pa dang*/ rgyal pos dbyug pa tshangs mgo can thogs te 'thabs pas 'jig rten thams cad bsngangs pa na tshangs pas byon te so so'i las su zad kyis gshin rjes ma nyes mod/

'on kyang bram ze'i bu ci 'drar yod pa ri mor bris shig rgyal pos ri mor bris pa de tshangs pas mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs nas bram ze la byin no// yi dwags la gcer bu zhes bya bas de thul ba legs so zhes rgyal po gcer thul dang*/ dang por ri mo 'dri ba po yin pas dang por bri ba po zhes btags/ tshangs pa'i bkas rgyal pos kyang gshin rje la phyag dang mchod pa byas te kun dga' bar gyur to// slar rgyal pos tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du song ste ri mo bri tshul zhus pas/ ri yi mchog ni ri rab yin// sgo nga las skyes rnams kyi ni// gtso bo nam mkha' lding yin no// mi yi gtso bo sa bdag ste// de bzhin ri mo sgyu rtsal gtso// zhes sogs dang*/ rgyal po de bzhin sgyu rtsal kun// ri mo'i las la yang dag brten// zhes sogs rgya cher bstan te/ de nas ri mo dar ba'i lo rgyus byung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa 'di la ston pa'i sku gzugs 'bur las kyang bris sku snga bar byung ste/ de'i yang dang po ni grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying pos sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal por u drā ya ṇa la bskur ba'i bris sku ste/ de'ang rgyal po de gnyis ring du gnas kyang ma mthong mdza' bar gyur te phan tshun skyes bsring ba la/ nam zhig u drā ya ṇas nor bu'i go khrab yan lag lnga ldan rin thang ma mchis pa zhig bskur ba dang*/ de'i skyes lan gzhal dka' bar gzugs can snying pos ri mo pa la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku 'drir bcug pas de rnams sangs rgyas kyi sku lta bas mi ngom pas yid phrogs par gyur nas tshad blang ma shes par/ ston pa chu 'gram du bzhugs te chu'i nang sku brnyan 'char ba dper byas nas/ 'og tu rten 'brel bcas bris pa la chu lon mar grags pa de nyid gser dang dngul dang zangs rnams kyi rim pa'i dong bur bcug

de gos kyis dril nas glang po che'i rgyab tu bkal te/ khyod la bdag gis 'jig rten gsum na ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i skyes 'di bskur gyi/ khyod kyis dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du bsu ba gyis shig ces 'phrin yig bskur ro// u drā ya ṇas kyang de bzhin bsus nas/ pho nya de dag gis phyogs yangs par sku gzugs de zhal phye ba na/ yul dbus kyi tshong pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i sgra phyung bar/ rgyal pos sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos ma thag tu spu zing byed de/ shes ldan dag sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de su zhig lha shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba de nyid sangs rgyas pa'i sku gzugs lags so// de mthong ma thag rgyal po dga' ste de'i nub mo rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs bzlog la bltas pas bden pa mthong nas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la khyod la brten nas bdag gis 'khor ba ni mthar byas na dge slong mthong bar 'dod do zhes 'phrin yig springs so// de gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das la gsol te 'phags pa kā tyā ya na 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa btang bas/ rgyal pos bsu ste gtsug lag khang lnga brgya bskrun pa sogs bstan pa dar bar byas so// gnyis pa ni ston pas 'od btang ba'i bris sku siṅga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can la bskur ba ste/ de'ang mnyan yod pa'i tshong pa rnams siṅga la'i gling du phyin te sangs rgyas kyi sgra bsgrags pas/ rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can gyis thos nas dad de/ des ston pa la yi ge gsol ba tshong pa rnams kyis phul ba'i lan du/ ras kyi gzhi ma la ri mo ji ltar thob pa'i 'od zer bkye ste/ de steng ri mos mnan pa'i thang sku ni skye mched shin tu gtsang ba zhig ste/ de dang spring yig stsal bas bu mos bden pa mthong ste/

slar mu tig bre bo che gsum 'bul du bskur ba ston pas dkon mchog gsum la bgo bar mdzad do// de nas brtsams te rgyal ba'i bstan pa gang du dar ba de dang der/ ras bris kyi srol chen po shin tu dar ba ma byung ba med cing*/ 'bur sku'i thog ma ni tsandan gyi jo bo zhes pa ste/ de'ang bcom ldan 'das yum gyi don du lha gnas su gshegs pa'i shul du grong khyer gsal ldan gyi rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pas mchod pa'i yul du tsandan gyi rgyu las grub pa ston pa dngos kyi sku dang 'dra bar bzheng par 'dod pa na/ maung gal gyi bu'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas bzo bos lha yul du phyin te sku'i dbyibs ji ltar bzhugs pa yid la nges par byas te 'ongs nas/ gsal ldan du ston pa'i sku brnyan dngos dang 'dra ba bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mdun du me shel 'od 'bar bas shin tu snang bar byed pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa mthong na mi mthun pa med par bskrun te/ phyis bcom ldan 'das lha yul nas bi shwa karmas sprul pa'i rin chen them skas las babs pa'i tshul gyis gshegs pa'i tshe tsandan gyi sku des kyang gsal ldan du gom pa drug bor te bsu ba byas par grags pa de nyid da lta rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs shing*/ sku de las bshus pa'i si thang zhes bya ba byung ba sogs lo rgyus rags pa tsam dang*/ bod yul 'dir chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon rnam gsum la sogs pa rgyal ba'i sras chen rnams kyi sku drin la brten bris 'bur gyi dar srol shin tu che ba byung ba dang*/ khyad par bris sku ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi ston pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i sku tshad can la dper byas pa'i bris rgyun rgya gar bal po la sogs pa la yod pa'i rgyun rnams phal cher bal po'i lha bzo bas bris pas bal bris zhes dar srol che ba byung ba dang*/ phyi nas rim gyis mkhas pa bkra shis rgyal po zhes bya ba la/

slob ma rang las mkhas pa sman bla don grub pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ lho brag sman thang du sku 'khrungs pa dang lho brag sman thang gi mtshal kha yang thon pa byung zhing*/ nar son pa dang sgra dang snyan dngags dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ lātstsha na dang*/ wartu la dang*/ nā ga ra dang*/ dha ri ka dang*/ bod kyi yig rigs du ma la byang chub par mdzad/ 'di nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa gdon mi za bar grags shing*/ rang gi chung mas yid 'byung ste yul 'khyams nas byon pa na/ yar 'brog stag lung du pir snod bcas dang bris dpe zhig rnyed/ de nas brtsams te bris la thugs phyogs te/ gtsang sa skya la sogs par lha bris mkhas pa 'tshol du phyin mthar/ mkhas pa bkra shis rgyal po dang thug nas/ de las ri mo'i tshul gsan cing byang chub par mdzad/ rang gi skye ba sngon ma rgya nag tu 'khrungs pa'i tshe bris pa'i zi'u thang rgya mdzod chen por grags pa de gzigs pa tsam gyis sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis rgyal rigs dang nye ba'i ldan lugs kyi ri mo'i tshul thugs la bkra lam gyis shar ba byung*/ gzhan yang ri mo'i ring lugs mang po dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang sdom pa 'byung ba rtsa 'grel gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ sku gzugs kyi tshad kyi rab tu byed pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad bshad pa/ mi 'thad pa'i phyogs kyi gzhung dgag pa/ tshad dang mi ldan pa'i skyon bshad pa/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung dgod pa/ tshad dang ldan pa'i yon tan brjod pa/ lha bzo dang sbyin bdag gi mtshan nyid/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rgyas par bshad pa ste bdun gyis gtan la phab pa mdzad do// yang gong dkar sgang stod nas mkhyen brtse chen po zhes pa byung ba de gnyis so so'i lugs cung zad mi 'dra ba mkhyen lugs dang*/ gzhan yang sprul sku bye'u zhes pa yar stod du 'khrungs shing bris la brtson pas shog dpe dang byang shing 'bral med du bcang zhing bris rgyun legs pa dang bris dpe legs pa 'tshol zhing phyogs kun du myul ba zhig byung bar brten/

sprul sku 'di bye'u dang dbyer ma mchis zhes 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas byi'ur ming thogs pa zhig ste/ de ni sman mkhyen dang ri mo'i lugs cung mi mthun pa bcas lugs srol gsum du gyes pa sogs las rim par dar rgyas su byung bar thos so// gsum pa de dag gi tshad bstan pa la/ 'jal byed dang*/ gzhal bya gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir sor gyi brgyad cha la nas dang nas gnyis la rkang pa dang*/ rkang pa bzhi la sor gang ngam cha chung ngam cha phran dang*/ de phyed dang bcu gsum mam bcu gnyis skabs su gang babs kyis gdong ngam zhal lam thal mo'am mtho zhes bya ste/ 'dis ni thams cad la tshad du 'jal bar byed do// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pas/ sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// ces gsungs pa'i don/ 'dir ston pa shākya'i rgyal po lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa zhig gi dbang du byas te/ dper brjod na/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa la so mo brgya nyer lnga pa chu zheng gab pa ni shrī dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rgyal ba'i bdag po gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su phyed dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur// de nas mgrin pa'i chu skyes de bzhin snying ga dang ni de nas lte gsang chu skyes de bzhin no// zhabs kyi mthil dang rje ngar brla dang dpyi yang ma nu de nyid de nyid rig byed rnams kyis te// brang phyed phyed bcas nyi ma'i rang dpung dpung lag rnams ni mkha' mig rgyal po nyi ma'i tshad kyis so// nyi shu rtsa lnga lhag pa'i brgya phrag gang zhig dus dang dgu yi mi rnams kyi ni 'jig rten tshad// rig byed phyed dang bcas pa'i bzhi dang chu gter chu gter phyed dang bcas pa'i rig byed rig byed kyi// gtsug tor mgo bo'i 'og tu 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i dpal ldan dpral ba dag dang shangs dang ni// shangs kyi 'og tu kos ko'i mtha' dang de nas mgrin pa dag ste mgrin pa rtsa ba'i chu skyes dbus// de nas snying ga lte ba gsang bar mi yi bdag po phyed bcas nyi ma rnams kyi rim pas so// gsang ba'i chu skyes lte ba'i rtsa bar rdo rje dag kyang thub pa yi ni steng gi gtsug tor nyid// ces gsungs pa'i don sku gzugs mtho bcu par byas pa'i mtho re la sor phyed dang bcas pa'i bcu gnyis su byas nas 'dir rags pa tsam zhig bshad na/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu'i gtsug tor gyi dpangs la sor bzhi/ de nas skra mtshams kyi bar sor phyed dang lnga/ de bzhin du rim par mdzod spu dang shangs rtse sor bzhi re/ kos ko sor phyed dang lnga/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ thugs ka dang lte ba dang gsang ba rnams su zhal re ste sku'i phyed tshad la cha phran phyed dang bcas pa'i re gnyis dang*/ de bzhin du dpyi la sor bzhi/ brla zhal do/ pus mo sor bzhi/ rje ngar zhal do/ zhabs dpangs sor phyed dang lnga ste phyed tshad la phyed bcas re gnyis rnams bsgril pa chur sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang*/ zheng la tshangs logs nas mchan khung bar zhal gang*/ de bzhin du dpung lhu sor nyi shu/ phyag ngar bcu drug gung mo'i rtse'i mthar thug pa'i phyag la sor bcu gnyis/ gru mo dang mkhrig ma'i mtshams su sor re ste phyed tshad la sor mo phyed bcas re gnyis rnams dril bas zheng la sor mo brgya nyer lngar 'byung ngo*// yang rgyud sdom pa 'byung ba rim par phye ba sum cu pa las/ mthil lam thal mo bcu gnyis kyi// lha yi gzugs ni bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ zab mo rdo rje can gyi lha// cha ni bcu gnyis mtshan nyid do// zhes cha bcu gnyis su gsungs pa gdan dang thor tshugs zhal re bsdoms pa'i zhal bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba ma gtogs pa sku tshad dngos gzhi la mtho bcu pa srid zheng gong ma dang 'dra mod/ 'dir zhal ni bcu gnyis cha yin no zhes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa las gzhan pa'i sku'i tshad la sor mo brgya nyi shu par gsungs pa dang*/ sprul sku 'phrang kha bas mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ger dkyus kyi bshad pa ni sman bla don grub pa dang mi mthun pa med kyang*/ de'i mchan bu zhig tu sor brgya nyer lnga pa 'bur dang brgya nyi shu pa bris sku'i khyad par yin pa'i ngos bzung 'dug par brten/ phyis kyi mkhas pa dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad dus 'khor nas bstan pa'i sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa ni 'bur gyi lugs dang*/

sdom 'byung nas bshad pa'i sor mo brgya nyi shu pa ni bris kyi dbang du byas pa yin zhes smra ba rnams ni ma brtags par smras par zad do// ci'i phyir na sdom 'byung gi 'grel par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa 'byung ba lan du mar bstan te/ de nyid du/ zhal gyi yang bcu gnyis cha dang cha chung dang*// sor dang sor mo zhes pa don gcig ste/ de thams cad du cha chung rnam par dbye ba shes par bya'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs nyid la phyed dang bcas pa'i cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i zhal bya'o zhes dang*/ bcu gnyis cha zhes pa ni sangs rgyas las gzhan thams cad thun mong ba nyid du gsungs pa'o zhes dang*/ yang ji srid sku gzugs byed pa de srid kyi tshad kyi tshangs thig btab nas/ de'i bcu cha la thal mor rnam par gzhag cing*/ slar de phyed dang bcas pa'i cha chung bcu gnyis su byas la de'i cha gcig ni cha chung du nges par bya ste zhes sku gzugs mtho bcu pa dang zhal gyi tshad la phyed bcas bcu gnyis su bshad pa'i phyir sor mo brgya nyer lnga 'byung ba las 'os ci yod/ de bzhin du sngon gyi mkhas pa mang pos cha tshad kyi yi ge rnams las kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa bris 'bur khyad med du dgos par bshad pa dang*/ khyad par sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i yi ge ni lugs 'dir rgya gzhung lta bur khas len dgos mod/ der yang mchog gi sprul sku'i tshad la sor brgya nyer lnga pa ni bris 'bur khyad med du lan mang por bshad pa'i phyir/ de gnyis bris 'bur so so'i lugs su byas pa ni rang dgar byas par sems so// 'o na de'i tshad ji ltar yin snyam na/ bshad par bya ste/ gzhan thams cad gong dus kyi 'khor lo nas bstan pa ltar las/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ srid du der dpyi la sor bzhi yod pa 'dir mi 'byung yang*/ brla dang byin pa'i mtshams su ni// sor mo bzhi dang yang dag ldan// zhes pas pus mo'i lha nga sor mo gsum pa'i steng 'og ste brla dang byin pa'i mtshams su sor mo gnyis gnyis te bzhi 'byung ba dang*/

pus mo la slar 'grel par sor gcig bsnan pa rnams kyis srid la sor mo brgya nyer lnga 'byung ngo*// zheng la'ang dus 'khor lugs la dpung lhu nyi shu dang phyag ngar bcu drug ces bgrang ba'i dbang gis mkhrig ma dang gru mo'i mtshams su sor re re bsnan yang*/ 'dir/ phyag ni thal mo gsum pa ste// thal mo 'di yis phyag mgo gnyis// zhes mchan khung nas mkhrig ma'i bar thal mo gsum dang phyag mgo'i thal mo bcas pa'i phyed pa rnams bgrang ba dril bas zheng la sor mo brgya nyer lnga 'byung ngo*// thig chen gnyis pa de las gzhan pa byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa zhi ba thun mong ba 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad can rnams ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i 'grel par/ mtshams dang mtshams la so sor cha chung gnyis gnyis chad par 'gyur te/ des na byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa zhi ba'i lha rnams la sku'i stod dang smad dag gi cha chung phyed dang bcas pa gnyis gnyis phri ba las cha chung nyi shu lhag pa brgya'i tshad kyi skur 'gyur ro zhes dgongs pa'o zhes dang*/ yang sangs rgyas kyi tshad bstan pa'i rjes thogs su/ 'di dag ni re zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang dpal bde mchog gi mtshan nyid de/ byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnams kyi'ang 'di dag kho na'o// 'on kyang thal mo bcu rnams la'ang thal mo so sor cha chung phyed phyed dor nas cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i thal mos thal mo bcu'i rnam gzhag bya'o zhes dang*/ bslab btus las kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang sor bcu gnyis pa'i mtho bcu pa nyid do zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad ji lta ba bzhin las khyad par ni/ cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i zhal tshad kyis gzhal bas sor mo brgya nyi shu pa 'byung ste go bar sla'o// thig chen gsum pa rgyal yum yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs can rnams ni/ sdom pa 'byung bar/ yid du 'ong ba'i rang gzugs ni// thal mo dgu pa mngon par 'dri// zhes yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs nyid de/

'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa dkyil 'khor pa'i lha mo rnams lus kyi srid zheng la thal mo dgu pa ste/ de'ang thal mo'i tshad dang 'gros ni sor mo brgya nyi shu pa'i phyogs dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni/ thod dpangs dang mgrin pa nas cha chung re re dor bas gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i mthar thug bar mtho phyed lnga dang*/ sku smad la brla dang byin pa'i mtshams kyi sor mo bzhi dang pus mo dang bol nas sor re re dor bas gsang ba'i gnas nas zhabs kyi mthar thug par mtho phyed lnga ste dril bas sor mo brgyad kyis lhag pa'i brgya 'byung bas srid kyi tshad rtogs shing*/ mchan khung dang dpung lhu dang phyag ngar rnams nas sor mo do re dbri bas de dang mnyam pa'i zhing gi tshad kyang rtogs so// rgyud 'grel du 'di nas 'og gi mtho brgyad pa'i skabs mar sbrel ba ltar byung ba ni 'gyur byed kyis bcad ma legs pa yin gyi/ thig khongs 'dir lha'i bud med rnams dang dbang po dang nye dbang dang chu lha dang dbang phyug dang rlung dang tshangs pa dang gza' zhi ba dang klu rnams kyi'ang ngo zhes de thams cad kyang 'dir 'du bar shes par bya'o// thig chen bzhi pa sbom thung gtum drag can rnams ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ khro bo khro mo dbang phyug ma// bran pho bran mo ci bgyi ma// drag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs rnams ni// thal mo brgyad pa rnam par 'dri// zhes 'byung zhing*/ 'grel par gdan gyi mtha' nas skra'i zhags pa'i bar du shes par bya'o zhes dang*/ yang thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba'i khro bo gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa ni thal mo brgyad ces gsungs pa dang*/ bris rgyun dang bcas par gtum drag can gyi cha tshad la sku'i ngo bo la zhal tshad drug dang*/ gdan dang skra zhal re bcas thal mo brgyad par bshad cing*/ zhib par gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud rim par phye ba bcu bzhi pa las 'byung ba'i don ni zhabs dpangs sor bzhi 'gying stabs med pa'i thad mar brkyang ba'i rje ngar sor bco brgyad la 'gying stabs kyi mtho gang*/

pus mo sor bzhi dang brla sor bco brgyad du bshad na'ang 'gying stabs kyi lto bar gab pa'i gsang ba'i gnas nas mgrin pa man chad la mtho gsum/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ zhal ras dang skra la mtho re ste srid kyi tshad dang*/ brang zheng phyed la cha phran nam sor bcu/ dpung lhu sor bcu bzhi/ phyag ngar dang phyag mgo zhal tshad re ste srid zheng mnyam pa go drug bshad kyang 'gying stabs kyi dbang gis nges pa med pas mkhas pas nyams dang sbyar shes dgos te/ thig khongs 'dir gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo rnams dang*/ thags bzangs ris dang lus ngan dang bden bral dang gshin rje dang me lha dang gza' drag po rnams 'du bar shes par bya'o// thig chen lnga pa mi'u thung ltar khros pa rnams ni/ krī ya sa mutstshar/ rā hu la dang mi'u thung dang tshogs kyi bdag po rnams ni mtho lnga pa bya'o zhes dang*/ grub chen nag po pas/ mi'u thung la chu so gsum gyis pus mo yan chad khyab par gnas so zhes gsungs pa'i don/ lag tu blang byar/ zhal dang*/ thugs ka dang*/ lte ba dang*/ chu so rnams mtho re dang*/ brla ni zhal gang lto bar gab pa dang*/ byin pa zhal gang dang*/ thod dpangs dang mgrin pa dang*/ pus tshigs dang*/ rting pa rnams sor gsum re bsdoms pas srid du sor mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ brang zheng zhal gang*/ dpung lhu sor drug phyag ngar dang phyag mgo zhal tshad re ste thig khongs 'dir gur mgon dang tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa 'du ba shes par zhes bya'o// thig chen drug pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa mi rnams kyi tshad ni/ dri med 'od las/ de nyid sems can rnams kyi khru bzhi ste/ mi rnams kyi sor dgu bcu rtsa drug go /steng dang 'og tu ni sor brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste de ltar mi rnams ni mtshan dang mi ldan pa'o zhes pa ste/ de'ang nyan thos rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshad ltar skabs rer bshad pa yang yod cing lag len la'ang bris thang tshad ma rnams su de ltar byas pa mthong zhing*/

rang rgyal la sogs pa ni mi'i tshad 'di byed pa la/ de'ang srid du khru phyed bzhi dang*/ zheng du khru bzhi par bshad pa dang*/ gso ba rig pa nas khru bzhir bshad pa mi'i tshad la btab tu btub ste lus 'dom gang khru bzhi yod la khru re ni rang gi mtho gnyis re rags par yin la/ de'ang rang sangs rgyas ni gtsug tor cung zad 'phags pa ltag pa'i char nye ba can te/ skra'i dpangs sor bzhi/ gdong la mtho gang*/ mgrin par sor do// snying ga lte ba gsang ba'i bar rnams mtho re/ brla dang rje ngar zhal phyed do re dang*/ pus mo dang zhabs dpangs sor gsum re byas pas srid kyi tshad do// thig chen brgyad pa sku'i rnam 'gyur rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ padma'i skyil krung dang*/ sems dpa'i skyil krung dang*/ dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs dang*/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang*/ tsog pu dang*/ g.yon rol dang*/ g.yas rol dang*/ bde legs can dang*/ g.yas brkyang dang*/ g.yon brkyang dang*/ sa ga dang*/ zlum po dang*/ mnyam pa'i stabs te bzhugs stangs kyi khyad par rnams dang*/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya la sogs pa phyag rgya mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i cha byad kyi chos gos gsum dang*/ 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed sogs kyi tshad dbyibs rab 'bring sogs dang*/ zhi drag so so'i rgyan cha'i bye brag mang po dang*/ gdan khri dang rgyab yol rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams kyi tshad dang dbyibs dang*/ rgyud sde rnams nas bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor so so'i thig dang*/ las so so'i thab kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid la sogs pa rnams ni bka' dang bstan bcos tshad ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas sgrub par shin tu 'bad par rigs te/ de lta bu'i tshad dang mi ldan pa'i skyon dang tshad dang ldan pa'i yon tan mang du gsungs kyang*/ mdor bsdus pa/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i 'grel par/ mtshan nyid rnams ldan sku gzugs ni// zhi ba la sogs nyams dang ldan// tshad dang nye ba'i tshad kyis mdzes// de lta bu la rab gnas 'gyur// sku gzugs byed pa 'jig rten na// tshad dang nye tshad dman rnams kyis// nad dang 'chi dang nor 'joms so// de bzhin gnyen dang 'bral bar 'gyur// cha shas thams cad mdzes gyur pa// thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i mchog

/dman min lhag pa min pa'i sku// gsungs pa'i tshad ldan mchod pa bya// gzugs dang dbyibs kyi rang bzhin dang*// snying rje gdan dang rol pa dang*// gnas kyi kha dog yang dag ldan// de la lha ni nye bar 'gyur// zhes so// gzhan yang gsung gi rten yi ge'i rigs dang thugs kyi rten mchod rten cha tshad kyi dbye ba rnams ni 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas re zhig bzhag go /gnyis pa la/ gang gis rtsom pa'i bdag rkyen/ su zhig rtsom pa'i grogs/ nam brtsams pa'i dus/ brtsam pa la zhugs pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa// brgya byin tshangs pa de bzhin 'jig rten skyong*// 'khor los sgyur dang mi yi rgyal por 'gyur// bde dang yid bde byang chub de 'tshang rgya// zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du ji skad smos ma thag pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi rigs rus shing sā la chen po lta bu'i rgyud du skye ba dam pa'i dpag bsam gyi sdong po yongs su bzung ba/ sa'i steng gi mi'i dbang phyug dpal sde dge bla ma chen po kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes rnam gsal grags pa'i zla ris dkar pos phyogs nas phyogs dang khor yug nas khor yug yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor kun du snang ba dam pa'i yi ge 'dri bar byed pa/ sgrun du med pa'i bsod nams kyi shugs bdo zhing chos dang rgyal srid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pas kun nas brgyan pa/ gang de'i phrin las dzambu gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs ma stong gis sgeg pas/ tha gru dpag par dka' ba'i dbyig 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor gang dag bdag gir bgyid cing dge ba'i khrims dang rjes su mthun par bskyang ba la gnod pa dang bsdo ba med pa/ gcig tu thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi dkyil 'khor gang de/

gzhar yang 'bying ba med par bla nas blar 'degs pa'i cho ga kun la snying stobs mi dman khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa las ches brling ba/ gang gi ngo mtshar legs byas rnam par thar pa phyogs bral smra ba mkhas pa yongs kyis snyan dngags mchog gi glur blangs kyang mur thug pa yod snyam mi bgyid pa'i bdag nyid can gang yin pa de ni legs byas rmad du byung ba 'di nyid rtsom par byed pa'i bdag po'i rkyen no// gnyis pa ni/ sdom brtson mi'i dbang phyug chen po de'i bka' lung gser gyi gnya' shing ltar rnam par lci bas legs byas rtsom pa'i grogs ldan gyi bkod pa stsal bar/ las byed yongs kyi mes po do dam khur len pa rnams gong gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i skabs su smos pa rnams dang*/ 'dir lha ris pa ni/ bzo gnas rig pa'i gtsug lag phreng ba 'dzin pa smad shod a 'phel dang*/ karma'i lha dga' sogs/ dpal yul dang*/ mkhar mdo dang*/ karma lha steng pa rnams mang po'i nang nas bkrabs te/ de'ang gtsug lag khang dngos la ka ba bzhi bcu tham pa mchis par zhing khams nyi shu rtsa dgu byung ba'i zhing khams gnyis re la lha ris pa dpon g.yog lnga re dang thun mong du tshon las pa dang bcas pa bsdoms pa'i dpon g.yog brgyad cu tsam bsags/ dbus kyi gtso chen ni/ bka'i dgongs 'grel rin po che yongs rdzogs kyi zhus dag dang kha ta pa yin gshis/ deng yang de dag bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i gtso chen ston pa'i sku brnyan gyi skya ris dang*/ lha ris pa gzhan rnams kyi kha ta par bcas 'dan phrug bdag la dgos tshul phebs par/ bdag gi yang mes gong ma lha bzo sangs rgyas lha dbang zhes pa bod chen 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram na sman mkhyen gnyis pa lta bu'i mkhas mthong byung ba dang*/ des bskrun pa'i lha la ye shes pa zhugs pa'i rtags re mi 'byung mi srid par grags shing*/ de'i srol bzhag lta bus gzhon pa'i skabs su lha ris kyi bslab sbyangs cung zad bgyis mod/

phyis nas zhor lus su song nas yun ring yin na'ang*/ bka' lung rin po che spyi bor lhung ba gyen bzlog ma spobs par de bzhin bgyi bar khas blangs pa dang bcas pa rnams nyer bsdogs su bstar ro// gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/ dus tshes dge ba'i rten 'brel gyis// las kun la ni phan bde ster// zhes pa ltar spyir gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs nyes thams cad rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba bzang can gyi stobs las 'byung dgos pas/ 'dir yang mngon par 'dod pa'i bgyi ba gang la thog mtha' bar gsum du gegs med par shin tu bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir thog mar dus tshes dang gza' skar sbyor byed phal cher legs pa 'dzom pa'i dus zhig ste/ de'ang rnam byung sa 'brug gi lo la lha mi'i ston pa bla na med pa gang de shākya'i sras po don thams cad grub pa'i skye bar bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas sngon chad byung ba med pa'i ngo mtshar ltas kyi phreng ba dang chab cig par lumbi nī'i tshal du dri ma med pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor legs par shar ba ltar bltams nas bgrang gzhi sum stong dang dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa brgyad sngon du brgal lo// chu pho spre'ur brtse ba chen po lag na padma nyid rang gi gdul byar rjes su chags pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol pa dpal sa skya pa kun dga' snying po pa de nyid kha'u skyed lhas su bstan srung dbang po rjes su 'brang bzhin par bltams nas bgrang gzhi drug brgya dang brgyad 'das shing*/ shing stag gi lo la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro la rjes su brtse ba'i them skas las/ ngur smrig 'chang gi gar gyis babs pa mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po rje btsun e waṃ pa'i chos kyi khri ga la ba der zhabs kyi chu skyes rnam par bkod de/ rgyal ba dges pa'i phrin las nyi ma'i 'od zer bye ba phrag brgyas phyogs kyi tha gru ma lus pa dog por bkang nas bgrang bya bcu gsum brgal lo// sa lug gi lo la rgyal sras snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba'i chos tshul mi nub gong du mngon par gdegs phyir sa skyong snying stobs chen po'i skye bar bzung ba sdom brtson bla ma chen po kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde nyid/

sde dge gong ma'i bstan srid kyi khri la zhabs zung mi 'gyur brtan par bkod de/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong ba'i legs mdzad kyi zla zer dkar pos khor yug yangs par khyab par byas nas bgrang bya bkra shis kyi grangs dang ldan par brgal ba'i gsar tshes kyi gnam lo/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du pra bha wa ste rab byung dang*/ shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu tang ma'u dang*/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming ni me mo yos su bod pa/ pho brang gling dgu'i dbus su sman gyi me long gis bsti ba'i 'byung ba sum ldan se zhig gi lo/ bsil zer ldan pa'i klung dang ldan pa/ zhag gi phung po dus 'khor ba'i dbyar 'bring po snron gyis nya ba/ nyin mor byed pa 'khrig pa'i khyim du rtsen pa hor gyi zla ba lnga pa/ rgya rtsis kyi ston rwa ba/ mngon 'dul lugs kyi dus tshigs lngar dbye ba'i dpyid zla gsum pa/ phug khyung lugs kyi nag rtsis pa'i shing sprel/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi stong pa dang po/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs u/ gsal byed ṭhu/ 'byung ba chu/ 'dod yon gzugs so// dbyangs 'char ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs e/ gsal byed pha/ 'byung ba rlung*/ 'dod yon reg pa/ dar gud rgan pa/ nyi ma sbrul/ spar kha zon/ sme ba bzhi ljang*/ gza' zla ba dang skar ma wa ste bdud rtsi sbyor ba'i dga' ston sar pa 'gyed pa'i sbyor ba dge ba'i nyin mor thig gi cha dbye ba nas brtsams te so sos 'dri ba'i 'go brtsam mo// bzhi pa ni/ de'ang dpal ldan sdom brtson mi rje dam pa 'dis ni bgyi ba dang bgyi ba ma yin pa'i blang dor gyi gnas thams cad bla ma'i bka' la legs par ma mnyan par rang dgas 'jug ldog byed pa ni 'ga' yang mi srid pa ltar/ 'dir gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang kun du bri bar bya ba'i lha'i bkod pa thams cad kyang mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kyis thor bkod pa gnang ba ltar 'dri ba las/

lha ris pa mkhas dman dang sku brnyan gyi tshugs bzang ngan gyi khyad par rnams dang po nas gzigs 'bul blangs shing*/ 'dri ba'i skabs kyang sa skyong bla ma nyid nas spyan ras kyi gzigs pas phab par bzo gnas rig pa gang la'ang de dang der yun ring por sbyangs pa lta bus thugs nyams che bas thon lo tsam gyis dgyes par bskyed mi thub par brten/ 'dir yang zhib dpyod mdzad pa'i dbang gis phyogs 'ga' zhig nas bzo bcos mang rab dgos pa byung ba rnams ni nam thugs la babs pa ma byung ba de srid du bzo bcos byas pa dang*/ gzhi nas lha ris pa rnams kyang mkhas btus bgyis pa sha stag yin gshis/ gtso 'khor dang stod smad kun du ri mo cha mnyam zhing bcad mdangs gser ris sogs gang la'ang legs rab cig byung song*/ gzhan yang rgya mthongs kyi logs dang phyi rol gyi khor yug gi ldebs dang bcas pa 'dri yul che tsam mchis na'ang tha skar zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs nas gegs med nyid du yongs su grub par bris zin pa byung ngo*// smras pa/ gang zhig

skyed byed 'grub ba'i rgyu/ dang ba'i sems kyis bskrun pa'am// mchod pa'i phreng bas bsti stang byas pa yi// rnam smin 'bras bu yid 'ong 'byin pa de// mtshan nyid dang ldan rgyal ba'i snang brnyan nyid// ston byung ba 'gog pa/ pa'i bris sku mthong gyur skye bo 'ga'// bden mthong gtam de nges min yang na ni// gzhan don 'byung ba dngos dang gzugs brnyan gnyis// mtshungs pa smon lam mthu chen zhig tu khums// chu zheng yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ mnyam ldan gzugs sku sgrub pa'i tshad// gnyis med dus 'khor ma rgyud sdom 'byung sogs// dri med lung gi drang thig btab tsam gyis// tshangs pa'i blo yang dgye dgu'i rang bzhin ston// gzugs de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ bzang thob byed bus pa'i byi dor nyid// ma yin rgyal ba'i sku mdzes bskrun pa'i mthu// gang 'dod gsol ba btab 'byung dpag bsam shing*// min no bsod nams bde ster dam pa'i sku// mthong ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtag na mi mthun med pa'i sku gcig cig /bzhengs pa'i legs byas gzugs su ldang srid na// stong gsum yangs par ma sprul gser mngal can// 'gyod pas gnyid bral brdzu la zhugs kyis dogs// gtsug lag khang chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng las/ brten pa rten gsum ji ltar bskrun pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs byang smos pa ni/ 'dir gtsug lag khang dngos la ka ba bzhi bcu mchis pa'i nang logs ldebs bris zhing khams kyi gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bdun las/ dbus kyi gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan bdud 'dul gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na ston pa'i 'khor shes rab can gyi mchog shā ri'i bu/

g.yon na rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog maung gal gyi bu gnyis bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ gtso chen gyi g.yas phyogs nas mar la rim par/ gtso bo dang po kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su bka'i sdud mdzad nye ba 'khor/ g.yon du kun dga' bo/ gtso bo gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad/ 'di nas brtsams te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcu'i gtso bo'i g.yon phyogs bcu po ma gtogs pa'i gtso bo thams cad kyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gleng gzhis dngos su bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po nyer lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas bcu po'i g.yon du ni yum nas bshad pa'i phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' bcu rnams bzhugs pa'i/ gtso bo 'di'i g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong*/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'byung gnas/ gtso bo gsum pa bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi thog ma de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' rin chen snying po/ g.yon du rin chen byin/ gtso bo bzhi pa shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas/ g.yas su rgyal sras ded dpon dam pa/ g.yon du shar phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba/ gtso bo lnga pa lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' skyes bus byin/ g.yon du lho phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med/ gtso bo drug pa nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' skyob sbed/ g.yon du nub phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros/ gtso bo bdun pa byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' chu bdag lha/ g.yon du byang phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' rgyal bas byin/

gtso bo brgyad pa byang shar mtshams kyi sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' glang pos byin/ g.yon nu byang shar mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pa/ gtso bo dgu pa shar lho mtshams kyi sangs rgyas padmo dam pa'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i stobs/ g.yon du shar lho'i byang chub sems dpa' lag na padma/ gtso bo bcu pa lho nub mtshams kyi sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' blo gros dam pa/ g.yon du lho nub kyi byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma rab snang*/ gtso bo bcu gcig pa nub byang mtshams kyi sangs rgyas gdugs dam pa/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i blo gros/ g.yon du nub byang gi byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mchog gtso bo bcu gnyis pa 'og phyogs kyi sangs rgyas padmo'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 'phel ba/ g.yon du 'og phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' padmo dam pa/ gtso chen ston pa'i sku'i g.yon phyogs nas mar la rim par/ gtso bo dang po kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa/ g.yon du lha'i dbang po kau shi ka gtso bo gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa mgon po/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mtha' yas/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' don yod mthong*/ gtso bo gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' sgrib med blo gros/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' rab tu zhugs pa/ gtso bo bzhi pa sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' mthu dam pas rnam par gnon pa/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus mtha' yas/ gtso bo lnga pa steng phyogs kyi sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtson pa/

g.yon du steng phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas byin/ gtso bo drug pa nas sangs rgyas sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa nas bstan pa'i bde bar gshegs pa bdun las sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying po/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i snying po/ gtso bo bdun pa sangs rgyas mtshan legs dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' rgyan chen po/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' mi gtong brtson pa/ gtso bo brgyad pa sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs rgyal po/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang*/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' blo gros dpe med/ gtso bo dgu pa sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med dpal/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob/ gtso bo bcu pa sangs rgyas mya ngan med/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' bdud stobs rab tu 'joms pa/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i blo gros/ gtso bo bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin chen phyag rgya/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu lag brkyang*/ gtso bo bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas kun mkhyen rgyal po/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' rgyan chen po/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' snying rje che sems/ gtso bo de dag gi 'khor du steng phyogs nas gdan khri yan chad du mdo sde bskal pa bzang po nas bstan pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las byung ba'i sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga/ gtso bo gnyis re'i mdun du gnas brtan spyan 'dren pa'i mdo dang dgra bcom pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lung bstan las 'byung ba'i gnas brtan bcu drug tshar re ste/ bsdoms pa gnas brtan tshar bcu dang*/ dharma tā dang rgyal po ha shang tshar gnyis/ rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pas bskor ba/

g.yas logs kyi mtha'i sgo 'gram gtso bo rdo rje gur gyi rgyud sogs nas bstan pa'i gur gyi mgon po/ steng phyogs nas sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa chen po'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ gzhan yang mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnams dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ mgon dkar/ e ka dza ṭī/ 'dod khams bdag mo/ ber nag zangs gri can/ zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs/ gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra bha ṭa/ srin mo ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dur khrod yab yum/ dmag zor rgyal mo/ bran bdud/ dpal mgon stag zhon/ gnod sbyin beg tse rnams kyis bskor ba/ g.yon logs kyi mtha'i sgo 'gram du ngal bsos po'i pho brang 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gar mkhan mchog dang mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud sogs nas bstan pa'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ de'i steng na thub dbang*/ phyag na rdo rje nas bu ston rin po che yan gyi bla ma brgyud pa/ 'khor sa dang po'i phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs brgyad du gnod sbyin chen po dzambha la sogs rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor sa bar pa dang tha mar rma bya chen mo'i gzungs sogs nas bstan pa'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa'o// rgya mthongs kyi logs gsum du gtso bo bcu gsum bzhugs pa'i dbus su sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang mthun par grub thob chen po brgyad cu la g.yas phyogs nas rim par klu sgrub/ mtsho skyes zhabs/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ lū hi pa/ ind+ra bhū ti/ sa ra ha/ g.yon phyogs nas rim par bi rū pa/ 'phags pa lha/ ḍombi he ru ka nag po spyod pa/ padma badzra/ ku ku ri pa rnams gtso bor byas shing*/

lhag ma rnams 'khor gyi tshul du bkod pa/ rgya mthongs kyi mdun logs dbus su spyan ras gzigs kha sar pā ṇi bzhengs stabs can la don yod zhags pa lha bzhi dang dmar po skor gsum gyis bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su so so 'brang ma la srung ba'i lha mo gzhan bzhi dang*/ gdugs dkar mo/ nor rgyun ma/ dzambha la dkar ser mthing gsum gyis bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa la 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du yum chen mo la thub pa/ 'jam dpal nag po/ smra ba'i seng ge dbyangs can ma/ mi g.yo ba/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma/ seng gdong sngon mo/ de'i g.yon du sgrol ma ljang gu la sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo steng gi yug rings la dbus su spyan ras gzigs gtso bor byas pa'i rigs gsum mgon po bzhengs stabs can la/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ pa gor bai ro tsa na/ gtsang de wend+ra rakṣi ta/ de'i g.yas su ka ma la shrī la/ bo dhi satwa/ ra wend+ra rakṣi ta/ dzñā nend+ra rakṣi ta/ ratna rakṣi ta/ glang khams pa go cha/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ srong btsan sgam po/ khri ral pa can/ thon mi sambho ṭa/ yon tan mgon po/ de'i g.yas su slob dpon klu sgrub sogs 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ mchog gnyis/ ma ti tsi tra/ zla grags/ ratnā ka ra/ de'i g.yas su kun dga' bo sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang*/ legs ldan byed/ sa kha'i lha/ tsand+ra go mī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ de'i g.yas su rgyal chen 'phags skyes po dang mig mi bzang*/ sgo gong du grub chen bi rū pa'i rnam thar/ de'i g.yas su padma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor gsum la gu ru mtshan brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang dbyug sngon can gnyis rnams so// gtso bo'i g.yon du ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la sa skya'i rje btsun rnam pa lnga dang*/

rga ā nan dam pa/ rdzong pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ de'i g.yon du 'khon nā gend+ra rakṣi ta la lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rwa lo tsā ba/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ 'gos lo tsā ba lhas btsas/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ yar lung lo tsā ba/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ dpang lo tsā ba/ bu ston lo tsā ba/ de'i g.yon du birwa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug shong lo tsā ba/ thang stong rgyal po/ sa lo tsā ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ sde dge grub thob kun dga' rgya mtsho/ de'i g.yon du rgyal chen yul 'khor srung dang rnam thos sras/ sgo gong du birwa pa'i rnam thar gyi 'phros te 'di'i rtogs brjod kyi zhal byang gong ma'i gsung rab kyi brjod bya rtogs par sla ba'i phyir kho bos tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pa utpa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bris so// de'i g.yon du padma 'byung gnas la rje 'bangs nyer lngas bskor ba/ de'i g.yon du khro bo mi g.yo ba dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnyis rnams te/ de dag gi gsham du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rgya bod kyi yul gru rags rim zhig rnams so// bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi gtsug lag khang gi lha'i dkar chag logs su mchis pa ltar dang*/ de'i rgya mthongs la dbus su sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga/ de'i g.yas su tshe dpag med lha dgu/ de'i g.yas su rje btsun seng ge sgra la brgyud rim 'ga' re dang*/ yum nas bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lhag ma gnyis rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i g.yon du rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu/ de'i g.yon du seng lding nags kyi sgrol ma la jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig bar khang mdun logs la sbyin bdag gi skor te/ dbus su rgyal ba'i sras chen sdom brtson bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i skye bar bzung ba sde dge bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan/

de'i phrag gong g.yas pa'i thad kar deng nas byang chub bar gyi skye bar skyabs kyi dam pa dang mi 'bral zhing mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'brel bas chos dang srid pa'i phrin las kyi snang ba mu med phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor kun du khyab pas bstan don rgya chen bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel du mkhan po rin po che bstan pa'i nyin byed dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gtso bor byas pa la/ yar lung ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ sku dbon rin chen mchog grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rong po sangs rgyas bstan pa/ sa kho bla ma ting 'dzin phun tshogs/ rje btsun nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dbon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ldan lo tshul khrims rin chen rnams kyis bskor ba/ mdun du gsol gzims mchod dpon phyag mdzod sogs dang*/ rgya gar dang kha che dang bal bod dang rgya nag gi mi rigs mang pos mchod pa 'bul tshul/ 'phrag gong g.yon pa'i thad kar lnga rig bstan pa'i snang byed si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sku brnyan la/ rdzogs chen sprul sku dang nyi grags sprul sku sogs kyis bskor ba/ sde dge bla ma'i sku'i g.yas su bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho dang*/ g.yon du lha sras bsod nams mgon po/ de dag thams cad kyi mdun du mdun 'khor gnyer pa las 'dzin 'ga' re dang*/ 'phags yul dang*/ kasmi ra dang*/ nai pa la/ bod dang*/ bod chen po dang*/ rgya nag la sogs pa'i mi sna mang pos 'dud cing lha mi'i dpal phun sum tshogs pas mchod 'bul stob pa'i tshul can/ g.yas logs kyi gtso bo sde dge khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sku brnyan gtsug tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs bzhugs shing*/ 'khor du sde dge gdung rabs 'gar ye shes bzang po nas jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang gi bar gyis bskor ba/ g.yon logs su chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gi sku brnyan gtsug tu thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub bzhugs shing*/

'khor du sde dge grub thob nas dbon po rgya bo'i bar bris so// phyi sgo'i sgo khang du g.yas su mngon pa nas bshad pa'i khams gsum 'jig rten gyi bkod pa mdor bsdus/ g.yon du 'dul ba lung nas bstan pa'i srid pa'i 'khor lo rnams bris so// gnyis pa gsung rten gsung rab la gtsug lag khang steng gi bar khyams kun du drwa mig gi khri la bka'i dgongs 'grel bod kyi brdar 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi phyi mo glegs bam nyis brgya dang dgu/ bla ma'i rnam thar skor dang bai ḍūr dkar po sogs gsar bskrun glegs bam bcu bdun tsam dang*/ gtsug lag khang rnying pa'i steng gi bar khyams kun du rgyal gsung 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi phyi mo glegs bam brgya dang bzhi/ gzhan yang mdo sna dang 'don chog rnam bshad sogs kyi skor shin tu mang bar bzhugs te de dag gi dkar chag rags bsdus gyang logs la yod pa ltar ro// gsum pa thugs rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa'ang rim gyis gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i dgongs 'jog ste/ mdor na rten gsum dpag tu med pas gtams pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po 'di ni 'jig rten gsum gyi snying por gyur pa lha mir bcas pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med pa nyid du nges pa'o// smras pa/ tshogs

yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ gnyis byed po'i lag pa zlos bu'i gar// 'bum phrag bsgyur ba'i rtsal gyis legs bris pa'i// dge mtshan dpe byad bzang pos 'jig rten gsum// rab snang ston pa shākya seng ges mtshon// ldan pa'i gzugs can/ bskal pa bzang po'i padma'i chu gter ngogs// thub dbang sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas gang byon dang*// 'byon gyur rnams kyi mi mthun med pa'i sku// stong phrag bsod nams yangs pa'i mgron du bkra/ /rigs rang bzhin brjod pa/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi gdul bya rigs can gsum// sgrib gsum yur ba'i gnyen por chos kyi sgra// lhun grub 'byin pa'i dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs// sras dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan 'dren byed dpyid// rnam rkang pa dang po dang gsum par yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ dag ting 'dzin sngags kyi shing rtar brten// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub mi zad skyes// rnam mang khur du 'dren pa yi dam lha// mkha' dbyings rlung gi rgyal mtshan gzugs kyi zla// thos yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ bsam sgom pa'i sbyangs pa mi dman pas// shes bya zab dang rgya ches bsdus so 'tshal// ston pa nyid dang dgongs pa gcig mkhyen nas// tshul bzhin 'doms pa'i mkhas dang grub brnyes tshogs// rig yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ pa'i gtsug lag kun 'jug rnam dpyod mig /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i bar bgrad pa'i// khongs su 'thibs bu'i gnyid sangs paṇḍi ta// skad gnyis smra dang chos rgyal bod kyi rje// dam rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ tshig rdo rje'i re khā snying gar bkod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bur bcas// skyong ba'i gur mgon la sogs srung ma rnams// bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral la spro bas 'khod// gang bai dharba'i lugs kyi rgya che ba/ zhig dpal gyi 'byung gnas legs thob pa// de nas bzung ste srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi// sgrub thabs gzhan la rtun pa lhod 'gyur ba'i// nor sbyin ngal bsos mgon po 'khor dang bcas// rgyal

rab brtag bstan kha ba'i ljongs su dar ro 'tshal// bla nas blar 'degs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gi /snying stobs 'di mthong phyugs bdag 'jug pa yang*// chu gter dmar po'i klong du bros min nam// gtsug lag khang chos mdzod bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng las/ brtsams pa'i rten gyi bzhugs byang smos pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// //gsum pa brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/ las byed pa yon gyis mnyes par byas pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa ji ltar bsgrub pa dang*/ dge ba byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba'o// dang po ni/ spyir sdom brtson sa skyong chen po 'dis/ bka'i dgongs 'grel rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar snga na med pa'i legs byas rgya chen po 'di bskrun pa'i ring la/ mi dpon 'ga' zhig che 'dod dang grags 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs te dge chos byed pa rnams kyang gzhan la khral 'jog dang*/ bza' yon med pa'i 'u lag btsan bskul byed pa'i srol mchis pa de lta bu min par/ de'ang las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba'i mdo las/ ji ltar gang zag las 'di lta bur gyur pas sngar yang bde la/ phyis kyang bde bar 'gyur ba'i las gang yin zhe na/ gang zag su yang rung ste sbyin pa byin pa yang mang po dang rangs par byin/ bdag kyang yid dga' ste byin pas phyis kyang me 'gyod pa'i gang zag de'i 'bras bu ni/ mir skyes na yang phyug po'i rigs su skye ste nor mang por spyod pa dang*/ mang po'i jo bor gyur nas blon po dang*/ grogs po dang*/ gnyen dang rigs gcig pa mang du bdog pa dang*/ bang mdzod thams cad gang zhing bde ba'i rigs su skye ste/ gang zag las 'di lta bu 'dus pas sngar yang bde/ phyis kyang bde bar 'gyur ro zhes 'byung ba ltar sngon gyi sbyin pa'i stobs las byung ba'i dpal 'byor mdzad med rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po'i phun sum tshogs pa'i gter gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag yongs su phye ba lta bu mnga' ba las/

gtong phod mi dman phyag gi dpag bsam ring por brkyangs nas/ bzo'i las byed pa thams cad kyang bza' btung dang yon gyi dngos po ji ltar 'os pa so sor star ba'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i gtam ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla 'od gsar pa las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir rten gtsug lag khang ldebs bris dang bcas pa bskrun pa la zang zing dngos po btang ba'i rnam grangs cung zad bkar te gleng ba la/ spyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan tshad dang ldan pa bzheng pa'i ri mo pa ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos po stob pas mnyes par bya dgos pa'ang*/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las/ bris sku tshad dang ldan pa yongs su zin pa dang 'dri mkhan kho rang 'dod pa'i yon phab la sbyin par bya'o zhes 'byung ba dang rjes su mthun par gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa ldebs bris su bcas pa'i las byed par bsags pa la/ thog mar gtsug lag khang 'di bslang pa'i ring la shing gzhog mkhan/ shing rkos pa/ gyang bzo ba/ sa rdo 'pho len pa'i 'u lag gla len par bcas shin tu mang skabs su mi grangs stong phrag lhag tsam dang*/ de nas kyang brgyad brgya dang bdun brgya dang drug brgya sogs las skabs dang bstun par bsags shing*/ che las grub nas zhal ba sogs zhib chags pa/ shing tshon 'gyed pa'i lha ris pa dpon g.yog gzhan yang g.yos mkhan/ ja 'dren bcas bsdoms pa shin tu mang ba tsam dang*/ lo de'i phyi lor ldebs bris la lha ris pa dpon g.yog brgyad cu tsam mchis pa'i/ las byed 'u lag gla len par bcas thun mong bar nyin rer ja thug bcu gsum re dang rtsam pa 'dong phyed do re/ gla yon du ja dang*/ tha mi ka dang ras zung dang ya ba dang*/ dar dang gos chen snam phrug gi rigs dang*/ pags pa'i rigs/ rta phyugs kyi rigs bgo ba'i bye brag khro zangs la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba gang 'tsham btang ba rnams bya'i rtsis la phab na/ 'u lag gla len pa mi rer nyi ma bcu gnyis la ja bar khag

shing gzhog pa lnga bcu mchis pa'i shing mkhan dpon po mi rer nyi ma dgu re la bar khag de mchan ma dang gyeng bzo ba dang zhal mkhan rnams mi rer nyi ma bcu gnyis re la bar khag lha ris pa dpon g.yog brgyad cu mchis pa'i lha dpon mi rer nyi ma bzhi re la bar khag de mchan mar mi rer nyi ma drug re la bar khag tshon 'gyed pa nyi ma bdun re la bar khag tshon sbyor ba nyi ma bzhi re la bar khag gser gsol ba dang gser shog pa nyi ma drug re la bar khag tshon 'dur ba nyi ma brgyad re la bar khag ste/ de dag la bar skabs rnams su ston mo rnam gzhag sogs spyi srol ltar stsal ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ zhal gser/ gser shog tshon rtsi kha dog sna tshogs spyin la sogs pa'i nyer mkho thams cad dang*/ las kyi mgo tshugs nas bzo'i bya ba mthar phyin pa yan gyi las byed rnams kyi brgyags chas la song ba bcas bsdoms par rags rtsis kyi ja 'khor drug can sum stong dang lnga brgya gya brgyad tsam btang ba'i rgyu sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas mngon par bsgrubs pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ dam pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni mkha' ltar rnam pa kun tu rtag par bzhugs pa las gzhar yang 'pho ba mi mnga' ba'i phyir rab tu gnas par bgyir ci zhig 'on kyang kun rdzob tu dad can rnams kyis mchod 'os mtshar tu yid ches pa dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i gzhir 'gyur slad rab tu gnas par shin tu byar yod de/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun na rab tu bzhugs// rab tu gnas pa gang na'ang med// kun du mkha' ltar gnas pa la// cig shos kyis ni rab tu brtag /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas// rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtag /ces so// gzhan yang rten bzhengs nas rab gnas ma byas par yun du gnas na mi shis pa 'byung ba dang*/ de srid du mchod pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon rnams spang ba'i phyir/

'dir rab tu gnas par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i snang byed mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong zhal snga nas gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin dbang nam mkha' dpal bzang pa sogs bla ma dge slong sum cu rtsa lngas lag len 'khrul med kyi cho gas rab tu gnas par bgyis te srid gsum dam pa'i snying pos yongs su lci zhing bsod nams kyi zhing bla na ma mchis par mnga' gsol ba dang*/ der bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po nas kyang dga' ston spyan dbye'i mdun 'jog gya nom pa bstar ba bcas phyogs thams cad nas bkra shis pa'i mtshan ris phun sum tshogs pa ci yang bkra ba byung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/ tha dad phyogs nas chu klung mang po dag /rgya mtsho cher 'bab ro gcig 'gyur ba ltar// tha dad phyogs nas dge ba bsags byas pa// byang chub bsngos pa rnams kyang ro gcig 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag bsags pa byang chub tu bsngo bgos/ de la gsum las gang zhig bsngo bar bya ba'i dngos po la/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ste gsum gyi 'dir dang po ste/ de la'ang rgyu sbyor phun sum tshogs pas mngon par bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon nas/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i legs byas ji snyed mchis pa rnams te/ phal po che las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na gang yod pa'i// dge ba de dag yang yang bsgrubs pas na// 'gro ba kun la phan dang bde sems kyis// ye shes mkhas pa de dag yongs su bsngo// zhes so// gang du bsngo ba'i yul ni/ 'jig rten 'dir che bar grags pa gser gyi mngal can dang grags pa'i mu khyud dang*/ dpal mgrin la sogs pa 'khor ba'i bde 'bras dang*/

nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pa zhi bde'i go 'phang bsgrub pa'i ched du ma yin par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba'ang*/ yum las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa yin no// zhes dang*/ byams pas/ khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang*// zhes so// ji ltar bsngo ba ni/ bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sar bsngo ba ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ sems can khams ni tshad med la// phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o// zhes dang*/ cig shos chos thams cad bdag med par shes pa'i dmigs med kyi rnam pa can gyis/ dngos po dang bsam pa dang yul gsum po yongs su dag par shes pa'i shes rab kyi rgyas gdab pa ste/ sdud par/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang*// gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang*// chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na// de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin// zhes dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// zhes so// de dag gis yongs su bsngo ba'i rnam par gzhag pa nyung zad cig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i phyir dpal ldan daṇḍi'i zhabs kyi gzhung lugs kyi rgyud las nye bar 'phos pa'i tshigs su bcad pa cung zad bstar ba 'di ltar te/ rang bzhin brjod pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro la rab gzigs ye shes spyan// gzhar yang 'dzum pa med par nam nangs pa// mtha' yas mi mchog sras dang slob mar bcas// phyogs bral yangs pa'i mkha' dbyings khyab par blta/ /ldan pa'i gzugs can/ deng 'dir dpal ldan mi yi dbang phyug gis// byang chub spyod pa rmad byung thang mo cher// snying stobs mi dman gom pa bkod pa las// ngo mtshar rten gsum bkod pa'i dge ba gang*//

rigs brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed/ tshul 'dir tha dad phyogs nas lus can gyi// longs spyod sgo gsum rjes su 'brel bas mtshon// 'khor ba mya ngan las ni 'das par gyis// nye bar bsags pa'i legs byas mchis so 'tshal// gang zhig mthong ngam mtshan gyi yi ges kyang*// sems can don chen lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas// gang na med pa'i yon tan gter chen po// rang gzhan kun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu/ nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru// legs par gsungs dang rtogs pa dam pa'i chos// log pa'i lam 'phyan bdud dang mur 'dug gi /snying nad zug rngu slong gang rgyal gyur cig /lung dang nang shes byed kyi rgyu/ rigs pa'i rlom 'chang bye ba'i dbus// gzhung mang dpal gyi mgur nas legs 'jo bas// kun yid 'phrog pa'i 'phags blo sa skya pa'i// lugs mchog bskal pa srid du dar gyur cig / bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ thabs shes chos kyi yi ges mtshon pa'i bstan// dpyad gsum rnam dag sgeg mo'i rkang rtse yis// legs phye mkhas pa'i a sho ka phreng gis// gser ldan dkyil 'khor kun tu bklubs par shog /dpe'i gzugs can/ gzhung mang thos bsam sgrub pa'i dbyangs snyan can// zhi zhing ches dul dge 'dun padma'i phreng*// rkang drug glu len sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// rjes mtshungs nor 'dzin khur du lci gyur cig /yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ chab 'bangs kyis mtshon 'jig rten thams cad du// bde ba'i srog 'phrog nad dang bkres rngabs dang*// 'thab rtsod bskal pa'i thun gsum sngo bsangs ma// dge ba'i skya rengs shar 'phral zhi gyur cig / mtha' dag gzugs/ lo legs bde 'byor chu gter 'khyil pa'i klong*// mar gyur 'gro ba'i mkha' lding grangs med dag /mtho ris yon tan ro bda'i bcud 'thung zhing*// skyid myos ga zha snyan glur len par shog

/sdeṃ 'byor pa rgya che/ bzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i lang tsho'i dpal// dgeṃ byas bdag po'i rkyen du dar bab cing*// kun gyi bla mar gnam gyi mthongs yangs nas// rin chen khri 'phang mnga' gsol mi yi rje// rkang pa dang po gnyis su yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ rnam 'dren bstan pa de 'dzin mchog bcas dang*// rnam mang 'jig rten kunaṃ dgaṃ'i zlos gar gang*// phriṃn laṃs rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i mthar thug bgrod pa dang*// sdeṃ snod bstan pa'i rtsa lag brtan gyur cig /rab rang bzhin la bsnyon pa/ dwangs bloṃ groṃs yangs par shes bya'i gnas// bkrag tu che ba legs sbyangs stobs kyis min// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ che yang 'dri byed khams song ba// lan brgyar bris par nges so rgyal gyur cig / bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ rab brling bsoṃd namaṃs gnyis las 'thung mchog steng*// gtsug lag rab mthong lta byed stong gis mdzes// mi bdag mtho ris mgoṃn poṃ sras su bcas// chab srid skabs gsum grong na rtag mdzes shog /

dngos po'i dpe/ dag byed gter du che ba'i chu klung nas// phra mo zil pa'i bar bzhin chos phyir du// che chung zang zing 'bad rtsol dge ba'i 'brel// mchis dgu rdzogs pa'i byang chub smin gyur cig / 'gal ba'i gzugs can/ khyab 'jug bgrod byed bkrus pa'i dri ma med// drang srong ngag gi dmod pas ma bcings par// legs byas mtho ris klung gis sgrib pa gsum// lhag med gcod pa'i mthu rab rdzogs gyur cig / rang bzhin lhan cig brjod pa/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub che// mngon 'dod rgyal ba'i myu gu'i sems mchog dang*// lhan cig de rgyu spyod pa zab rgya che// ngoms med bsgrub pa'i spro ba brling gyur cig / yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ rang bzhin glo bur dri bral chos kyi sku// mthong na mi mthun rnam dben gzugs kyi sku// zung 'jug srid zhi'i mtha' chen gnyis 'gongs pa// gong na med pa'i mgon po mngon gyur cig / bai dharba'i sgra'i nyams/ dus gsum yul gru kun tu sgyu 'phrul gzugs// mtha' yas zla snang 'dra bar rab bstan nas// ji bzhin nyid kyis gzigs pa'i rim ji bzhin// chos 'khor nyon mongs 'joms mtshon yongs bskor shog / bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ bdag kyang byang chub snying po mchis bar du// dal 'byor rten ldan tshulaṃ khrimaṃs gsum gyis 'byor// gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn snang bas sems can khams// thams cad mkhyen lam gsal bar byed par shog /blo gtad mi bslu bden chen gtam gyi rnga// ched du brdung ba med par ldir ba'i dbyangs// lam gsum khongs kyi khengs pa 'gog bzod pa'i// bden pa des ni smras don 'grub gyur cig /gtsug lag khang chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng las brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'i skabs te bzhi pa'o//

//smras pa/ bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ gser ldan rum nas brtan mas yid 'phrog lus phyed thon// mi mchog tshogs bsags bden dpang thal sbyar snyan glur blangs// mtha' yas rgyal rnams mgrin pa snyan dngags dbyangs su bsdebs// bsngags pa'i yul gyur srid zhi'i ston pa shākya'i tog /de yi cha shas can gyi gzugs can/ chos tshul smra ba'i snang byed mchog rnams kyis// legs gsungs kha ba ri pa'i brda ru 'gyur ro 'tshal// gcig las du ma'i sgyu 'phrul phyi mo'i gandho la// chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mangs phye ba bskrun pa'i gtam// dpa' ba'i nyams ldan/ sum rtsen gnas su gom pa gcig cig bkod pa med// mkhar nyal gzhon nu'i skye ba nyid kyang blangs pa min// 'on te 'di na kun dga' skyed pa'i ro ldan pa// bdud rtsi'i thigs pa mi zad 'gyed pa'i res su son// rten phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ dang brten pa'i brjod bya 'khor ba'i phun tshogs min// blta na ngoms med ngo mtshar lus phra'i 'jo sgeg min// spros pa sna tshogs brgya byin tshon gyi stong gzugs min// de phyir tshul 'di snyan dngags smra la cis mi spro// skyed byed kyi rgyu/ de skad yi ge'i lam du rab song dge ba yis// zas gtsang sras kyi bka' lung 'chos skyob bcas pa'i chos// phyogs dus kun tu srid pas byas pa'i sdig pa yongs// 'joms pa'i mthu chen rab tu gzi 'bar dar gyur cig /sems rkang pa phyi ma dag la yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ can thams cad bde legs 'byung gzhi dkon mchog gsum// nges par brling bas de rten bskrun la rtag 'grus ldan// de mdun rnam mang mchod pa'i phreng rab bstar ba sogs// de bzhin gshegs pa sras bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /gser ngag don gyi dpe las bzhin sgra gcig pa/ gyi ri dbang nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od rtse yis// yongs su 'khyud bzhin bsod nams brgyas bskrun rgyal ba'i sku// lhun grub mtshan mchog dpe byad snang bas mdzes pa gang*// bdag dang 'gro bas ring por mi thogs 'grub gyur cig
